source: Madhya Pradesh Pollution Control Board (MPPCB) & Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)

circulars.title: Mandatory Continuous Emission / Effluent Monitoring for Red/Orange Category Industrial Units in Pithampur & Sanwer Road
circulars.issuing_authority: Madhya Pradesh Pollution Control Board, Bhopal
circulars.what_changed: Installation of IoT telemetry sensors on effluent discharge lines and stack emissions is now mandatory before consent renewal.
circulars.applicability: All electroplating, heat-treatment, foundry, and chemical processing MSMEs in Indore & Dhar districts.
circulars.action_required: Procure and calibrate CPCB/MPPCB empaneled IoT data-loggers; submit compliance affidavit on MPPCB XGN portal.
circulars.penalty_risk: Revocation of Consent to Operate (CTO) and environmental compensation cess under Section 33A of Water Act.

circulars.title: Advisory on Mandatory e-Invoicing Verification on GeM & ONDC B2B Transactions
circulars.issuing_authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
circulars.what_changed: B2B e-Invoices without a verified Invoice Reference Number (IRN) and embedded signed QR code will be rejected at GeM disbursement gate.
circulars.applicability: All registered MSME suppliers delivering to Central/State PSUs or Tier-1 OEMs.
circulars.action_required: Generate IRN via NIC e-Invoice API or GSP portal before dispatching consignment with e-Way bill.
circulars.penalty_risk: Disallowance of Input Tax Credit (ITC) for the buyer and penalty of Rs 10,000 or tax amount per invoice under Section 122.
